digest.component_or_area: test linting and CI gate (wall-clock assert detector)
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests/** cause CI flakiness under runner contention and must be detected at code-review time.

The detector must recognize two escape mechanisms: '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' line marker and '@pytest.mark.skipif(os.environ.get("CI") == "true")' guard; bare '@pytest.mark.benchmark' does NOT escape.

Two test sites require migration from wall-clock assertions to counting proxies: test_config_perf.py:201 (spy config._ordered_layers) and test_enrich_drain.py:261 (count pending_enrichment + drain calls).
The detector must be wired as a CI gate in the build-and-test workflow and block new unescaped upper-bound assertions with a teaching message naming both escapes.
